prompts.onion: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG isolated pizza topping for a high-quality children's cooking game. Ring hole must be genuinely transparent. Object centered with 12 percent transparent padding. No plate, no other food, no letters, no background, no cast shadow beyond a tiny soft contact shade. Match glossy softly textured pastel food assets rather than a flat vector icon. Required output is a usable standalone transparent game sprite, not a mockup.
